userBearer.description: Random 256-bit token, server-side SHA-256 digest, expires in 1 hour. Browser keeps it in memory only. Revocation, disabled user and role changes checked on every request.

serviceBearer.description: Separate service credential; never reuse browser access tokens. Issuance/rotation/actor delegation must be reviewed before implementation.
